Tongue Twister Generator

Get a random tongue twister from a built-in collection of 40 classics — tap for a new one and try saying it three times fast.

Press “New twister” to begin.

📖 How to use

  1. Tap “New twister” for a random one.
  2. Read it aloud three times fast.
  3. Try Challenge mode against the timer.
  4. Copy your favorites to share.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How many tongue twisters are included?

40 classic tongue twisters, from 'She sells seashells' to 'Peter Piper'.

Are they rated by difficulty?

Yes — a built-in difficulty tag (Easy, Medium, Hard) is shown with each twister.

Is there a challenge mode?

A “Say it 3× fast” challenge mode with a timer is built in — try to finish before time runs out.

Can I copy a twister?

Yes — copy any twister to share it.
